dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (Open COBOL) free-format source, part of the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS) by Vincent B Coen. Uses >>source free directive, GNU GPL v2, migrated from CIS COBOL. Version 3.02.23.
evidence: 'Migration to Open Cobol v3.00.00' in change log
GNU General Public License v2 copyright notice
copy 'envdiv.cob' and other .cob copybooks typical of GnuCOBOL projects

purpose.domain_detail: Sales Ledger Invoice Data Entry and Maintenance module of the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS). Handles invoice creation, credit notes, stock updates, VAT, analysis codes, and open item file posting.
purpose.summary: This program is the Invoice Data Entry and Maintenance module (SL910) of the ACAS sales ledger system. It supports both batch and immediate invoice printing, credit note processing, stock control integration, VAT handling, and posting to open item files. It calls numerous sub-modules for stock audit, stock, sales, delivery, analysis, deleted invoice numbers, invoices, and OTM3 open item file.

notable_features: 16 CALL statements to sub-modules (acas010-acas019, SL070, SL930, SL960 etc.)
106 PERFORM and 109 GOTO statements indicating complex legacy control flow
Screen-based interactive data entry (terminal/maps-based, not CICS)
Stock control integration with audit trail
GNU GPL v2 licensed open-source accounting system
REDEFINES used extensively for screen accept/display fields
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars but sufficient evidence present. Free-format GnuCOBOL with >>source free directive. The program is a substantial production module (~2281 lines) with 35+ years of change history. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS. Interactive terminal-based (screen maps) rather than CICS. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial calculations.
